alt: Mountain landscape used as cover art for Elden Ring
title: Elden Ring
description: An open-world action RPG from FromSoftware set in the Lands Between, where players explore vast regions, face brutal bosses and uncover a mythology crafted with George R. R. Martin.

alt: Forest path used as cover art for Baldur's Gate 3
title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: A party-based RPG by Larian Studios built on Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition rules, offering deep turn-based combat, branching choices and a story shaped by every decision.

alt: City skyline at night used as cover art for Hades II
title: Hades II
description: A roguelike dungeon crawler from Supergiant Games in which Melinoë, Princess of the Underworld, battles through the Greek myths to defeat the Titan of Time, Chronos.

alt: Waterfall in a green valley used as cover art for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: Nintendo's sequel to Breath of the Wild expands Hyrule into the skies and depths, letting Link build vehicles and contraptions with new abilities to solve puzzles freely.
